title.rendered: Anger Of Stick 5 Mod 1.1.89 Apk Download

content.rendered:
Download Anger of Stick 5 mod 1.1.89 apk, which is a very popular game for Android with stickmen moving around.

In the world of Anger stick, you will kill large amount of enemies that come your way to attack you, in return you attack them back.

Also, a lot of people have been turned to zombies in the city by strange elements, using them as experimental tools, it is now your responsibility to clear them by using the sophisticated weapons available in the game, such as guns and even chainsaw.

Call on two other fellows as a hero and you become three of you to rescue the city from enemies.

Unlimited money and bullets is what you will get in this mod of Anger Stick 5.
